morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays
stress_signals: 15% of ceramic manufacturing units have shut down due to high inventory and production slowdowns [64076d83f199]
Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]
what_to_watch: Inventory liquidation trends and warehouse stock levels across ceramic manufacturing accounts
Propane gas price movements and impact on unit-level operating margins and debt serviceability
Operational continuity and capacity utilization metrics to identify further potential unit closures

surat.headline: Textile sector faces margin and labor stress while diamond units witness festive demand rebound.
what_changed: Weaving units cut operating schedules to five days weekly and enforce strict 15-day yarn payment terms ahead of Diwali amid a reported 66% yarn price hike.
Textile and embroidery segments face compounding operational disruption from labor protests, leave disputes, and an early worker festive exodus.
Diamond manufacturers experience an uptick in demand, shortening Diwali vacations for the first time in four years and creating pressure to reverse prior wage cuts.
Multiple high-value fraud cases hit the cluster, including a Rs 15.57 crore textile scam and cheating cases spanning yarn, fabric, and diamond traders.
stress_signals: Steep 66% yarn price surge creates shutdown risks for textile units, prompting ministerial visits and operational curtailment [b62552cc0c7d, 17d2f5591336].
Cash conversion cycles tighten as weavers adopt two-day weekly holidays and mandate 15-day yarn payments amid festive recessionary headwinds [0c72a246c955, 28ff6df05700].

Elevated credit and counterparty risks evidenced by a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud, trader cheating cases, and a FOSTTA advisory warning against unverified agents [cf2229091691, 2718cba9f837, 9013ae33515c].

Extensive labor friction across embroidery and weaving units via two-month wage agitations, court disputes, and 'Gaon Chalo' early worker exits [6b7974c7f88e, 73dfcce5d3f4, a9383cbae2cf, b0d8a5269e4e].
improvement_signals: Diamond cluster activity rebounds with curtailed Diwali vacations and expectations for worker wage restorations [ff0f473e0921, 2b47ff4fa01a].
Testing and value-addition infrastructure expands with ICA-GemLab opening its first Indian lab and MANTRA positioning Surat as a testing hub [26bd1ecd549c, 0b9a805766c6]
Product diversification indicated by successful high-altitude testing of Surat-made fabric-coated balloon airships for defense surveillance [5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Compliance and reporting updates following regulatory directives for textile units to file returns on the TSRS portal.
Cash flow and working capital strain among weaving borrowers adapting to mandatory 15-day yarn payment cycles.
Production capacity utilization and debtor turnover days across textile units impacted by the early labor exodus and labor agitations.
